decision: Exclude the unreferenced path-label macro from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file defines PATHLABL, a macro for emitting public start and stop labels.
No include of pathmac.inc or invocation of PATHLABL was found in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include trees; the selected dependency inventory has no edge to it.
limitations: The exclusion covers only the selected core build and does not establish whether other DOS components use this macro.
